input.topic: How to spend three days in Tokyo for under $300, not counting flights

hook: How does ninety-nine dollars a day buy you the ultimate Tokyo vacation?
body:
First, buy a seventy-two hour unlimited subway pass at the airport for only ten dollars. This covers every train ride you will need.

Next, book a highly-rated capsule hotel in Shinjuku for thirty-five dollars a night. You get a clean, quiet pod and free toiletries.

For breakfast, skip western cafes. Grab a hot egg salad sandwich and a warm green tea from Lawson for under four dollars.

For dinner, use a ticket machine to order a massive, steaming bowl of authentic local tonkotsu ramen for only six dollars.

Spend your days exploring the historic Senso-ji Temple and Shibuya Crossing. For the best skyline views, use the free observation deck at the Metropolitan Government Building.

To experience the culture, walk through the neon-lit streets of Akihabara. Window shopping costs absolutely nothing.
cta: Save this video right now to plan your own budget trip to Tokyo.

meta.angle: You can experience the absolute best of Tokyo's food, transit, and sights for under ninety-nine dollars a day.
